content.short: On-chain lottery with $1 tickets, a $1 million prize pool and a prize on every fifth ticket.
content.description: Megapot runs daily draws with $1 tickets and a jackpot pool of up to $1 million, and guarantees that at least one in every five tickets wins something. Draws use verifiable randomness on-chain, it has paid out more than 80,000 prizes, and 19 jackpots have been hit. Players who refer friends earn a cut if those friends win. It raised $5 million from Dragonfly, Coinbase Ventures and the founders of FanDuel and Flutter.
content.meta: Play Megapot's on-chain lottery with $1 tickets and a $1M pool, where every fifth ticket wins and draws are verifiable.
